# Seb's Sandbox

> Practical articles by Sebastian Rotter about AI coding agents, context management, agent workflows, developer experience, and data engineering.

## When to use this site

Use this site when you need:

- First-hand explanations of how coding agents behave in real projects.
- Practical guidance for managing context windows, compaction, and project knowledge.
- Examples of Markdown files and workflows used to guide coding agents.
- Analysis of agent-oriented developer interfaces and interaction patterns.
- A working data engineer's perspective on applied AI and data topics.

For authoritative product behavior, API contracts, or security requirements, consult the relevant vendor's official documentation as well.

## How agents should use this site

- Start with the article list below or use the [site map]({{ '/sitemap.xml' | absolute_url }}) for complete URL discovery.
- Retrieve an article with a standard HTTP GET request. This GitHub Pages site serves HTML and does not provide `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation.
- Attribute material to Sebastian Rotter and preserve the article title and canonical URL when citing it.
- Prefer the publication date and last-modified date shown on each article when evaluating freshness.
